WebRTC RFC 8829 / RFC 9429 JSEP: iceRestart Credential Rotation, Transceiver Slot Reuse & Glare Rollback
P961 Fresh ice-ufrag/ice-pwd on iceRestart & Confirmed Port-0 Slot Reuse · P962 🎉 Glare Rollback to stable & Active BUNDLE Port>0 Lock
❌ Legacy JSEP Renegotiation Bugs (Stale ICE & Glare Crash)
1. Stale ice-ufrag/ice-pwd on iceRestart + Premature Slot Reuse
• Wi-Fi → 5G switch triggers iceRestart, but SDP reuses old ufrag/pwd
• Remote peer ignores ICE restart (RFC 8829 §5.2.2) → 100% dead audio
• Reusing m= slot before port=0 O/A completes overwrites active mid
2. Unhandled Offer Glare Collision & Accidental BUNDLE Port-0
• Both Agent & Client send SDP Offer in have-local-offer state
• Missing polite rollback crashes RTCPeerConnection signaling state
• Setting port=0 on active bundled m= line in re-Offer kills transceiver!
Enterprise Production Impact (Without P961–P962)
• Mobile handoff recovery fails silently when ufrag/pwd stay identical
• Tool-call track addition colliding with client mute tears down call
Verdict: BLOCK (Stale ICE Credentials / Unhandled Glare / Port-0 Drop)
✅ Deterministic JSEP RFC 8829 / RFC 9429 Guards (P961–P962 🎉)
P961: iceRestart Credential Rotation & Port-0 Slot Reuse Gate
• Enforce fresh ice-ufrag ([4,256] chars) & ice-pwd ([22,256] chars)
• Require newIceUfrag != old & newIcePwd != old on every iceRestart
• Recycle m= slot only after port=0 O/A completes + assign fresh a=mid
• unconfirmedPortZeroSlotReuses == 0 (0 active mid overwrites)
• Gate: evaluateWebrtcJsepRfc8829IceRestartCredentialRotation...()
P962 🎉 (971st Guard / 980th Probe): Glare Rollback & BUNDLE Gate
• Polite peer executes rollback from have-local-offer → stable
• Restore previous a=mid bindings before applying remote glare Offer
• Forbid port=0 on active bundled m= lines after initial BUNDLE O/A
• unhandledGlareCollisions == 0 & unexpectedBundledPortZeroDrops == 0
• Gate: evaluateWebrtcJsepRfc9429GlareRollbackStateAndBundle...()
Verdict: PASS (100% iceRestart Rotation · 0 Glare Drops · 926 Tests)
